mapper.sql: application_id, user_id, source_type, simulation_id, ai_scenario_id, rebalancing_id, applied_monthly_saving_amount, applied_investment_ratio, applied_expected_return_rate, applied_monthly_spending_amount, before_expected_asset, after_expected_asset, applied_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy_application ( user_id, source_type, simulation_id, ai_scenario_id, rebalancing_id, applied_monthly_saving_amount, applied_investment_ratio, applied_expected_return_rate, applied_monthly_spending_amount, before_expected_asset, after_expected_asset ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{sourceType}, #{simulationId}, #{aiScenarioId}, #{rebalancingId}, #{appliedMonthlySavingAmount}, #{appliedInvestmentRatio}, #{appliedExpectedReturnRate}, #{appliedMonthlySpendingAmount}, #{beforeExpectedAsset}, #{afterExpectedAsset} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM strategy_application WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY applied_at DESC, application_id DESC LIMIT 1
